messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Under Article 71(8) of Legislative Decree 81/2008, by whom must the checks (initial, periodic and extraordinary) on work equipment be carried out?

response.text: Ai sensi dell'articolo 71, comma 8, del decreto legislativo 81/2008, da chi devono essere effettuate le verifiche (iniziali, periodiche e straordinarie) sulle attrezzature di lavoro?
